license_required.quote: A person may not practice dentistry without a license.

issuing_authority.quote: Only a person licensed as a dentist by the Oregon Board of Dentistry may own, operate, conduct or maintain a dental practice, office or clinic in this state.

name.quote: Only a person licensed as a dentist by the Oregon Board of Dentistry may own, operate, conduct or maintain a dental practice, office or clinic in this state.

type.quote: The Oregon Board of Dentistry may discipline as provided in this section any person licensed to practice dentistry in this state

age_minimum.quote: An applicant for a dental license shall be entitled to take the examination to practice dentistry in Oregon if the applicant: (a) Is 18 years of age or older

degree_required.value: Graduate of an accredited dental education program
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of a dental school accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association or its successor agency, if any, which must have been approved by the Oregon Board of Dentistry.

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: Is a graduate of a dental school accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association or its successor agency

exams.name: Written examination
exams.notes: Board may accept results of national standardized examinations taken within five years
exams.quote: The Oregon Board of Dentistry may administer written, laboratory or clinical examinations to test professional knowledge and skills.

exams.name: Laboratory or clinical examination
exams.notes: Board shall accept results of regional and national testing agencies or clinical board examinations administered by other states
exams.quote: To satisfy the laboratory or clinical examination authorized under this section: (A) Shall accept the results of regional and national testing agencies or clinical board examinations administered by other states

interval_years.quote: Each dentist must renew the dentist's license every two years through submitting a renewal application and paying the license fee.

required.quote: To require evidence as determined by rule of continuing education or to require satisfactory evidence of operative competency before reissuing or renewing licenses for the practice of dentistry

available.quote: The board shall accept the results of regional and national testing agencies or of clinical board examinations administered by other states, and may accept results of board-recognized testing agencies, in satisfaction of the examinations authorized under this section for applicants who have engaged in the active practice of dentistry in other states

requirements.value: Applicants must have engaged in active practice of dentistry for at least 3,500 hours in the five years immediately preceding application and meet all other requirements for licensure
requirements.quote: for applicants who have engaged in the active practice of dentistry in other states, in Oregon or in the Armed Forces of the United States, the United States Public Health Service or the United States Department of Veterans Affairs for at least 3,500 hours in the five years immediately preceding application and who meet all other requirements for licensure.

regulatory_model.quote: A person may not practice dentistry without a license.

credential_type.quote: A person may not practice dentistry or purport to be a dentist without a valid license to practice dentistry issued by the Oregon Board of Dentistry.

is_mandatory.quote: A person may not practice dentistry or purport to be a dentist without a valid license to practice dentistry issued by the Oregon Board of Dentistry.

title_protection.quote: A person may not practice dentistry or purport to be a dentist without a valid license to practice dentistry issued by the Oregon Board of Dentistry.

scope_protection.quote: A person may not practice dentistry without a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any violation of law for which the court could impose punishment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any violation of the law for which the court could impose a punishment if the board makes the finding required by ORS 670.280.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Renting or lending a license or diploma to be used as another person's license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Renting or lending a license or diploma of the dentist to be used as the license or diploma of another person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined in the statute
Any violation of the dental practice chapter, related statutes, rules, or board orders
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of this chapter or ORS 680.010 to 680.205, of rules adopted pursuant to this chapter or ORS 680.010 to 680.205 or of an order issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in or permitting unacceptable patient care due to deliberate or negligent act or failure to act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in or permitting the performance of unacceptable patient care by the dentist or by any person working under the supervision of the dentist due to a deliberate or negligent act or failure to act by the dentist, regardless of whether actual injury to the patient is established.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully betraying confidences involved in the patient-dentist relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully betraying confidences involved in the patient-dentist relationship.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, aiding, abetting or permitting unlicensed personnel to practice dentistry, dental hygiene or dental therapy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing, aiding, abetting or permitting any unlicensed personnel to practice dentistry, dental hygiene or dental therapy.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making use of advertising statements that are deceptive, misleading, or untruthful
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making use of any advertising statements of a character tending to deceive or mislead the public or that are untruthful.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a controlled substance in any manner proscribed by board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a controlled substance in any manner proscribed by the rules of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or dispensing drugs outside the scope of dentistry or in a manner impairing health and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or dispensing drugs outside the scope of the practice of dentistry or in a manner that impairs the health and safety of an individual.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by a state licensing or regulatory agency of this or another state regarding a health care profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action by a state licensing or regulatory agency of this or another state regarding a license to practice dentistry, dental hygiene, dental therapy or any other health care profession when, in the judgment of the board, the act or conduct resulting in the disciplinary action bears a demonstrable relationship to the ability of the licensee or applicant to practice dentistry

definition_quote.value: "Dentistry" means the healing art concerned with: (A) The examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, treatment, care and prevention of conditions within the human oral cavity and maxillofacial region, and of conditions of adjacent or related tissues and structures; and (B) The prescribing, dispensing and administering of prescription drugs for purposes related to the activities described in subparagraph (A) of this paragraph.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the healing art concerned with: (A) The examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, treatment, care and prevention of conditions within the human oral cavity and maxillofacial region, and of conditions of adjacent or related tissues and structures; and (B) The prescribing, dispensing and administering of prescription drugs for purposes related to the activities described in subparagraph (A) of this paragraph.

value: examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, treatment, care and prevention of oral and maxillofacial conditions
prescribing, dispensing and administering prescription drugs
cutting, altering, repairing, removing, replacing or repositioning of hard or soft tissues
methods_authorized.quote: "Dentistry" includes, but is not limited to: (A) The cutting, altering, repairing, removing, replacing or repositioning of hard or soft tissues and other acts or procedures... (B) The prescription and administration of vaccines.

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe, dispense and administer prescription drugs for purposes related to dentistry, including vaccines
drug_authority.quote: The prescribing, dispensing and administering of prescription drugs for purposes related to the activities described in subparagraph (A) of this paragraph.

specialist_license_available.quote: A dentist licensed by the Oregon Board of Dentistry may advertise that the dentist is a specialist in one or more areas of dentistry if the dentist: (a) Has completed a post-doctoral residency program that is at least two years in length and is accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: A license issued to an applicant qualifying for a dental instructor's license who is a specialist by virtue of successful completion of an advanced dental education program is restricted to the specialty in which the dentist was trained.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means supervision requiring that a dentist diagnose the condition to be treated, that a dentist authorize the procedure to be performed, and that a dentist remain in the dental treatment room while the procedures are performed... "General supervision" means supervision requiring that a dentist authorize the procedures by standing orders, practice agreements or collaboration agreements, but not requiring that a dentist be present when the authorized procedures are performed... "Indirect supervision" means supervision requiring that a dentist authorize the procedures and that a dentist be on the premises while the procedures are performed.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: An expanded practice dental hygienist may render the services described in paragraphs (a) to (e) of this subsection to the patients described in subsection (1) of this section if the expanded practice dental hygienist has entered into an agreement in a format approved by the board with a dentist licensed under ORS chapter 679.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: "Expanded practice dental hygienist" means a dental hygienist who performs dental hygiene services in accordance with ORS 680.205 as authorized by an expanded practice dental hygienist permit issued by the board under ORS 680.200.

value: Patients or residents of nursing homes, adult foster homes, residential care facilities, adult congregate living facilities, mental health residential programs, facilities for persons with mental illness or developmental disabilities, correctional facilities, and public and nonprofit community health clinics who are unable to receive regular dental hygiene treatment
Students or enrollees of nursery schools, day care programs, Job Corps, primary and secondary schools, and persons entitled to benefits under the Women, Infants and Children Program
Patients in hospitals, medical clinics, medical offices or offices operated or staffed by naturopathic physicians, nurse practitioners, physician associates or midwives
Patients whose income is less than the federal poverty level
Other populations determined by the Oregon Board of Dentistry to be underserved or lack access to dental hygiene services
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: An expanded practice dental hygienist may render all services within the scope of practice of dental hygiene, as defined in ORS 679.010, without the supervision of a dentist and as authorized by the expanded practice dental hygienist permit to: (a) Patients or residents of the following facilities or programs who, due to age, infirmity or disability, are unable to receive regular dental hygiene treatment

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: The Oregon Board of Dentistry shall issue a license to practice dental therapy to an applicant who:

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: A dental therapist may practice dental therapy only under the supervision of a dentist and pursuant to a collaborative agreement with the dentist that outlines the supervision logistics and requirements for the dental therapist's practice.

value: Practice settings specified in the collaborative agreement
At least 51 percent of practice dedicated to underserved populations or dental care health professional shortage areas
dental_therapist_practice_setting_restri.quote: A dental therapist shall dedicate at least 51 percent of the dental therapist's practice to patients who represent underserved populations, as defined by the Oregon Health Authority by rule, or patients located in dental care health professional shortage areas

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Only a person licensed as a dentist by the Oregon Board of Dentistry may own, operate, conduct or maintain a dental practice, office or clinic in this state.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: A dentist may not use the services of any person who is not licensed to practice dentistry in this state to make, provide, repair or alter dental prosthetic appliances or other artificial materials or devices that are returned to a dentist and inserted into the human oral cavity, or that come into contact with the human oral cavity's adjacent structures and tissues, unless the dentist first provides to the person a work order

teledentistry_authorized.quote: A dental care provider authorized by the Oregon Board of Dentistry to practice dental care services may use telehealth if: (a) In the professional judgment of the dental care provider, the use of telehealth is an appropriate manner in which to provide a dental care service; and (b) The dental care provider is providing a dental care service that is within the scope of practice of the dental care provider.

interim_therapeutic_restoration_authoriz.quote: "interim therapeutic restoration" means a direct provisional restoration placed to temporarily stabilize a tooth until a dentist subsequently diagnoses the need for further definitive treatment

patient_record_retention_years.quote: A dentist shall retain for at least two years from the date of prescription a duplicate copy of each work order prescribed by the dentist.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: Presents documentation satisfactory to the board of successful completion of an emergency life support course for health professionals, including cardiopulmonary resuscitation, from an agency or educational institution approved by the board

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: "Expanded practice dental hygienist" means a dental hygienist who performs dental hygiene services in accordance with ORS 680.205 as authorized by an expanded practice dental hygienist permit issued by the board under ORS 680.200.
